The structure of Ca10Co2O14 (reduced formula Ca5CoO7) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/c (No. 15), with 26 atoms per unit cell distributed over five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies octahedral coordination for both Co and Ca centers, with Co–O distances of about 2.01 Å and Ca–O distances ranging from 2.40 to 2.46 Å. The octahedra share corners and edges, as observed from validated polyhedron contacts, and the geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 26 sites.
